=== Father relationship: Faris family review — 24 October 2026 ===

The existing father [[Glasgow-835|Robert Barclay Glasgow]] is now assessed at 97% (confident), up from 86% on 22 October 2026. This review supersedes the earlier father grade above.

The printed list names Robert Madison, born 16 April 1840 and died 29 January 1865 at Vicksburg, Mississippi. These exact dates, middle name and unusual death setting match Robert-2227’s military-hospital account. The same page reports Robert M. in Robert B.’s 1850 household, cohering with its explicit child list. The actual Faris pp. 46–47 were visually checked. They explicitly group these children under Robert Barclay Glasgow and Phoebe McFall; Robert’s own dates, two wives and Ohio–Iowa life identify the father account. These exact percentages are subjective assessments of each complete father/profile pair, not statistical measurements.<ref name="FarisRobertChildren1990">David Faris, ''The Glasgow Family of Adams County, Ohio'' (Baltimore: Gateway Press,1990), [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CS3J-H9F6-3 printed pp. 46–47], DGS 007834162,image 1583; actual printed pages visually checked 24 October 2026. Retrospective genealogy; original family and census records not inspected. The Bible provenance on p. 32 concerns the previous generation and is not asserted for this child list.</ref>

The household and list are statements in one compilation, not independent inspected census and military proofs. The original 1850 census, Roll of Honor and memorial images remain uninspected; no military or vital field is changed. This is one retrospective compiled family history. Its list, reported censuses, modern family fields and memorial citations may share evidence; repeated details are not independent proofs. No original birth register, census, Bible or burial record was newly inspected. The 1927 Bible provenance on p. 32 concerns William and Rhoda’s children, not the dates of Robert’s next generation; it is not transferred here. Existing named fathers remain selected. Mothers are separate, ungraded or unselected where previously so. No new parent attachment, merge or live save.
